page.content:
Psychiatrist who calls Michael 'purely and simply evil.'

How Dr. Sam Loomis connects

  • Creator: Donald Pleasence — Donald Pleasence played Dr. Loomis across the early films.
  • Work: Halloween (1978) — Loomis hunts Michael through the 1978 film.
  • Character: Michael Myers — Loomis spends the night trying to stop Michael.
  • Location: Smith's Grove Sanitarium — Loomis watched Michael for years at Smith's Grove.

What is Dr. Sam Loomis?

Dr. Sam Loomis is Michael's doctor at Smith's Grove, the one adult who treats him as a force to be stopped rather than a patient to be cured.

Key threads lead to Donald Pleasence, Halloween (1978), Michael Myers and Smith's Grove Sanitarium.
